objective: Add a readablePaths option to createAgentTools and the mission manifest. When readablePaths is nonempty, read, search, and list_files must expose only those exact files or descendants of admitted directories; an attempted direct read outside that scope must return a structured refusal without revealing bytes. Preserve unrestricted behavior when readablePaths is absent. Add deterministic tests in test/readable-paths.test.mjs.

agent-tools-compatibility.description: Agent tool source changes preserve the existing agent-tools contract.

mission-runtime-compatibility.description: Mission manifest projection changes preserve the existing mission runtime contract.

readable-scope.description: A dedicated test proves exact-file and directory readable scopes, structured out-of-scope refusal, no leaked protected bytes, and unrestricted backward compatibility.

constraints: Keep path confinement inside src/agent-tools.mjs and manifest projection inside src/mission-runtime.mjs.
All existing tests must remain green.
Use structured refusals rather than throwing for a model's out-of-readable-scope action.
